title: Find out whether boxes and ovals Ask draws land half a line too small
goal: When an SVG holding an outlined box or oval was read into layers, its line sat inside the box, so the shape came out half a line too small and lines meant to meet it stuck out. Opening a file now puts the line where the file says; Ask reads SVG through the same reader and may still have the fault, which would show on any outline icon it draws. Find out, and fix it if so.
notes: Not reproduced through Ask itself, hence p2 and a question. Seen through SVGArtwork.layers, which Ask also uses: lucide mail.svg scored 53.08 of 255 mean difference from macOS's drawing with the line inside the box and left the worst of the list once SVGOpening set style.borderPosition = .center. Ask's path was left alone on purpose: its grid landing and tests are pinned to today's numbers.
acceptance: An Ask drawing of an outlined box is compared with the SVG the model wrote, and the log says whether the box moved
If it did, the box lands where the SVG says, and the eval's climb and held-out totals are both reported
